profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer
profile.summary: With a keen aptitude for problem solving, I am pursuing an engineering opportunity in the research and application of computer science, applied mathematics, and data science.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented data tracking platform for web & mobile platforms on Google Cloud for Disney web & mobile services
- Assisted implementation of big data platform on AWS for ESPN websites & mobile apps
- Developed highly scalable API backend for data collection at billions of transactions daily
- Experienced in building real-time streaming data ingestion & processing pipeline for analytics and data science applications
- Experienced building ETL/ELT pipelines, with data processing tools (Hadoop, Spark, Dataflow)
- Experience with column-oriented databases (BigQuery, Vertica, Redshift)

positions.title: Data Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Received offer to extend internship part-time through the 2015-16 school year
- Converted to full-time upon graduating
